title: Word Stress That Changes Meaning
subtitle: Why English words sound wrong even when the pronunciation is correct
description: English word stress is unpredictable and can change meaning. Spanish stress is more regular. This sheet focuses on the most important stress patterns for Spanish learners at B1 level.

categories.title: Noun vs Verb Stress
categories.description: Many English words change stress depending on whether they are nouns or verbs. Spanish does not do this.

sentences.sentence: The PREsent is on the table.
They will preSENT the plan tomorrow.

categories.title: Stress in Longer Words
categories.description: English stress in longer words is often unpredictable and must be learned with the word.

sentences.sentence: We need to deVELop a solution.

categories.title: Stress Makes English Sound Natural
categories.description: Correct stress helps English sound fluent and confident. Flat stress makes speech harder to understand.

sentences.sentence: She is reSPONsible for the project.
